The conversation includes personal insights on fatherhood, longevity, and societal trends. (98 words)

summaries.en: Khabib Nurmagomedov, a undefeated UFC champion (29-0), discusses Dagestan's warrior culture, his training, and dominance in MMA. He reflects on his toughest fights, including the Khabib vs. Conor McGregor matchup, and ranks other great fighters like Fedor Emelianenko and Daniel Cormier. The interview also touches on coaching, Islam Makhachev, and his views on football, with insights into his discipline, lifestyle, and advice for young people. (100 words)

summaries.zh: 特伦斯·陶是史上最伟大的数学家之一，曾获菲尔兹奖和数学突破奖。他在流体力学的纳维-斯托克斯方程、数学物理与量子力学、素数与解析数论、调和分析等领域均有贡献，并解决了许多数学史上的难题。他还探讨了物理学、无限、数学与物理的关系、现实本质、万有理论等话题。此外，他讨论了AI在定理证明中的应用，如Lean编程语言和DeepMind的AlphaProof，并分析了人类数学家与AI的对比。

He has advanced solutions to many of mathematics' hardest problems and won major awards like the Fields Medal and Breakthrough Prize in Mathematics. The discussion explores challenges in mathematics and physics, the future of AI in solving complex problems, and comparisons between human and AI capabilities in mathematics.
